name: Madagascar Centella, Poremizing Deep Cleansing Foam, 6.22 fl oz (125 ml)
description:
Poremizing Deep Cleansing Foam

- All-in-one facial cleanser infused with Himalayan Pink Salt and Kaolin for deep cleansing

- Thick cream paste turns into a rich foam thoroughly washes off sunscreen leftovers,dirt and sebum in the pores

- Himalayan Pink Salt enriched with 80 minerals clears impurities in pores

- Papain (enzyme derived from papaya fruit) and vinegar exfoliate dead skin cells
